title: German Plum Skewers
description: Sweet and tangy plum skewers cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven, inspired by traditional German cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the plums and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Thread a plum, a tomato, and a few skewers onto each stick.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the skewers in the preheated Dutch oven and bake for 20-25 minutes.
Baste the skewers with the juices from the Dutch oven every 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
